summary: Require known Submittal status labels to consume the complete status value instead of matching a prose prefix.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy
The user previously rejected keyword-driven extraction that promotes descriptions into business entities
Offline reproductions promote Approved alternate and Pending delivery prose to formal Submittal statuses
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Unknown provider-specific dispositions remain neutral and require reviewer confirmation.
A status followed by commentary on the same line remains neutral unless the full value is already allowlisted.
The change does not infer approval authority, precedence or contractual effect.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, external provider or paid model is used.
